Dockerfile: Backend image for Render: python:3.11-slim, installs root requirements.txt, copies backend/, runs uvicorn on port 8000.
Makefile: Targets: dev-backend (uvicorn with reload), dev-frontend (Vite), dev (both via concurrently), graph (regenerate docs/repo-graph/), agent-graph (regenerate docs/repo-graph/AGENT_GRAPH.md from the compiled workflow; needs .env).
README.md: Product overview and architecture: the five LangGraph agents by event, no paid AI, the database tables; the How It Works steps still describe pre-2.0 behaviour.
backend/agents/evaluator_agent.py: Evaluator node, no LLM: turns stored session questions into grader inputs, grades a test with the local grader in one embedding call on a worker thread (reusing a pre-graded answer whose text is unchanged), writes feedback from templates, inserts test_results with score 0-10, feedback and confidence per answer, updates the rolling average in reading_progress and returns grades and one decisions entry; the first node of the submit flow; a question with no evidence is graded against the passage at low confidence.
backend/agents/evaluation/__init__.py: Package marker for backend.agents.evaluation, answer grading with no LLM.
backend/agents/evaluation/feedback.py: Feedback for a graded answer, pure: render(grade, evidence) builds one or two sentences from fixed templates, the question's key terms and a verbatim evidence snippet; low confidence gives no verdict, closed questions name the expected answer, free text says what was captured and missed and never 'correct'.
backend/agents/evaluation/grader.py: Answer grader: pure decide(GradeInput) gives a 0..1 score, a high, medium or low confidence, matched and missing key terms, the rule used and its components; cloze and multiple choice by exact or rapidfuzz match, free text by a weighted sum of evidence cosine, key-term coverage and a relevance check; grade_all embeds a test's free-text answers in one call with the embedder it is given.
backend/agents/graph.py: Builds the LangGraph workflow: event-driven flows from __start__ routed on state['event']: start_session -> planner; finish_reading -> test_generator; submit_answers -> evaluator -> knowledge_state -> optimizer -> planner (the optimizer is skipped when every grade is low-confidence, and an evaluator error ends the run); abandon -> optimizer.
backend/agents/optimizer_agent.py: Optimizer node, no LLM: reads progress and the stored pace recommendation (previous multiplier, recent percentages, recent question outcomes, question mix), the book's recent sessions (this one's words and minutes, earlier abandonments) and the profile speed; calls optimizer.pace.decide; stores the recommendation with its history and the re-read queue (creating the progress row for older books); returns it with one decisions entry. On abandon there is no test: the stopped session counts as abandoned and no score is recorded.
backend/agents/planner_agent.py: Planner node, no LLM: reads progress (creating it on a first session with nothing read), candidate sections, their concepts, the reader's mastery, question difficulty per section and the optimizer's last pace; calls planner.strategy.decide; pops a re-read from the queue only when a session starts with it (after a submit the plan is a preview); returns plan, session_plan and one decisions entry.
backend/agents/state.py: AgentState TypedDict shared by all agent nodes: identity, the event (start or submit), one output key per agent (plan, grades, mastery_updates, policy_adjustments), the append-only decisions audit trail (agent, inputs_summary, output_summary, reason, duration_ms, built by decision()) and errors (operator.add reducers), and the older keys the current nodes and routers still use.
backend/tests/test_agent_state.py: Pytest: AgentState declares the pipeline keys and keeps the old ones, decisions and errors are append-only through a compiled graph, event takes only start or submit, every key a node returns is declared, and the evaluator returns only its own decision.
backend/agents/test_generator_agent.py: Test generator node, no LLM: assembles the session's test from the question bank (question_bank.assemble_session_test) in the planner's question mix and returns it with one decisions entry; run by the finish_reading flow.
backend/dependencies.py: FastAPI dependencies: get_current_user resolves a Supabase JWT to a user id through supabase.auth.get_user (anything else is a 401); require_model waits up to EMBED_WAIT_SECONDS for the embedding model, starting a load if none is running, and answers 503 with Retry-After before the endpoint runs.
backend/main.py: FastAPI app: CORS, the six routers and /health (status, model_ready, timestamp; never waits on the model); its lifespan preloads the embedding model on a background thread unless EMBED_PRELOAD=0 and starts the ingestion sweep (backend/services/ingestion_worker.py) unless INGEST_SWEEP=0. Starts no other process.
backend/routers/mastery.py: GET /mastery?book_id=&limit=&offset=: the caller's concept mastery rows with their labels, weakest first, one page per call with the total; a page past the last row is empty.
backend/agents/knowledge_state/agent.py: The I/O around mastery.decide: record_test reads the reader's mastery rows for the concepts a graded test's questions name, moves them and upserts them with last_seen and next_review, once per session id (no round trip when no question names a concept); knowledge_state_node wraps it as the submit flow's second node, a failure being an errors entry.
backend/tests/test_api_mastery.py: Pytest on the in-memory database: record_test writes one row per concept with review dates, weighs low confidence, applies an event once and makes no round trip without concepts; GET /mastery needs a token and returns only the caller's rows, weakest first, with labels, paginated, empty past the end.
backend/mcp_server.py: Standalone FastMCP server with three Supabase tools (reading history, comprehension trend, chunk context); not started by the app since C3.4 and not called by any agent; kept for manual use.
backend/nlp/__init__.py: Package marker for backend.nlp, the local NLP building blocks (no API calls).
backend/nlp/concepts.py: Concepts of a chunk: YAKE key phrases, normalised (lower case, stopwords stripped, plurals reduced), near-duplicates merged by rapidfuzz, embedding cosine or shared words, each with a stable concept key slug and a 0..1 weight.
backend/nlp/embedder.py: Local embeddings: one thread-safe fastembed model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384 dimensions, cache in FASTEMBED_CACHE), preloaded and warmed on a daemon thread at startup unless EMBED_PRELOAD=0, or loaded on first use; a ready event that requests wait on and /health reports, and the load error if any; embed and embed_one return unit-length float32 vectors.
backend/nlp/text.py: Pure text utilities, standard library only: normalize (PDF hyphenation, line breaks, quotes), split_sentences with an abbreviation guard, tokenize, STOPWORDS, content_words, and informativeness, a 0..1 sentence score.
backend/routers/agent.py: Empty APIRouter mounted at /agent; defines no endpoints.
backend/routers/auth.py: GET /auth/profile and POST /auth/profile/calibrate: read the profile and save the calibrated reading speed.
backend/routers/books.py: Book endpoints: upload to Storage, record a processing_jobs row and ingest after the response; list; details with progress; status poll with the job's status, progress and cursor; resume a failed or stuck book's ingestion from its cursor; delete.
backend/routers/dashboard.py: GET /dashboard: aggregates book progress, scores over time, reading streak, words this week and recent feedback; its five reads run at once, only the needed columns are selected, and test answers are read a page of the newest results at a time until three feedback quotes are found.
backend/routers/sessions.py: Session lifecycle endpoints (evaluate-single and submit-answers wait for the embedding model through require_model), through backend/agents/workflow.py: start (the start_session flow plans; the session row is created here and the finish_reading flow assembles the test in the background, warming the grading model), finish-reading (returns the public part of the test, running finish_reading inline if it is not ready), evaluate-single (grades one answer inline and caches it; tells the client nothing), submit-answers (claims the session first, so it is graded once; a resubmit gets the stored result rebuilt from test_results; one submit_answers run: grades, mastery, pace and the next plan; returns score, feedback, confidence, the pace recommendation and the next session), abandon (marks the session, then runs the abandon flow after the response), get; every run's decisions are stored after the response; no answer or evidence is sent to the client before the test is submitted.
backend/services/book_ingestor.py: Extracts text from PDF and EPUB, chunks it by paragraph to about 600 words, and runs a claimed ingestion job from its cursor in bounded batches (five, then 16): embeds each batch with the local model, upserts it on (book_id, chunk_index), has the question generation agent fill the bank (and concepts) for the batch, marks the book ready once the first batch and its questions are stored, and saves the cursor; a failure is recorded on the job. Reads the file from Storage when resuming.
backend/services/retriever.py: Hybrid retrieval over one book's chunks: local-embedding vector search (match_chunks_local) and Postgres full-text search (search_chunks_text) merged with reciprocal rank fusion; get_similar_chunks keeps its signature.
backend/services/supabase_client.py: Creates the shared service-role Supabase client with its own HTTP/1.1 httpx pool (thread-safe; the default single HTTP/2 connection broke under threads, issue 29); fetch_all runs independent queries at once on worker threads; raises at import if the URL or key is missing.
backend/tests/conftest.py: Offline test setup: dummy environment (ingestion sweep and model preload off), a fake Supabase client, a guard that blocks non-loopback connections, and an autouse fixture that marks the embedding model ready.
backend/tests/test_backfill.py: Pytest on a fake table: the backfill embeds only rows with no local embedding, is idempotent and resumable, writes nothing on --dry-run, can be limited to one book, and refuses to run outside development.
backend/tests/test_auth.py: Pytest: get_current_user rejects a raw UUID token with 401 and returns the user id for a token Supabase accepts (supabase.auth mocked).
backend/tests/test_bench.py: Pytest: percentile, duration formatting, table rows including 'not measurable', and the Baseline section update in scripts/bench.py.
backend/tests/test_concepts.py: Pytest: plural reduction, phrase normalisation, concept key slugs, merging of identical, fuzzy, overlapping and embedding-close phrases, and extract_concepts on a fixed passage without the real model.
backend/tests/test_embedder.py: Pytest: embedder output shape, unit length, batching, lazy single load across threads and env settings on a fake model; the startup preload loads and warms once on a daemon thread, a caller's wait times out while it loads, a failed load is recorded and retried by the next ensure_loading, ensure_loading never waits for a load in progress, a lazy load also marks it ready, EMBED_PRELOAD; similar sentences beat unrelated ones on the real model when it is cached.
backend/tests/test_feedback.py: Pytest: each feedback template and its conditions, term lists, the evidence snippet, and over the labelled fixtures that feedback holds only template words, key terms and verbatim evidence.
backend/tests/test_grader.py: Pytest: closed-question matching, the free-text formula and its components, every confidence rule and its boundary, grade_all's single embedding call and its failure path, on hand-made numbers; plus agreement with the labelled answer fixtures on the real model when it is cached.
backend/tests/test_health.py: Pytest: /health returns 200 with exactly status, model_ready and timestamp, and answers at once while the model is still loading.
backend/tests/test_ingest_embeddings.py: Pytest on the in-memory database: bounded batches from the cursor, every chunk stored once with a local embedding and the job done, the book ready only once the first batch and its questions are stored, ready even if those questions fail, a crash keeps the cursor and a resume from Storage finishes without duplicate chunks or questions, a batch stored but not recorded is safe to rerun, error before the first batch, an empty book, a failing question agent.
backend/tests/test_ingestor.py: Pytest: chunk_text chunk counts, word bounds, paragraph integrity and content preservation.
backend/tests/test_text.py: Pytest, table-driven: sentence splitting (abbreviations, quotes, lists, hyphenated line breaks), normalisation, tokens, stopwords, and informativeness rankings.
backend/tests/test_migrations.py: Pytest: no migration has a destructive statement, and 005 adds embedding_local vector(384) with an HNSW cosine index and an RLS-respecting match_chunks_local, 006 adds the full-text index and search_chunks_text, 007 adds question_bank, 008 adds concepts and user_concept_mastery with their keys, indexes and own-rows policies, and 009 adds agent_decisions with its columns, indexes and a read-only own-rows policy, and 010 adds processing_jobs with its columns, sweep index, read-only own-rows policy and the unique chunks (book_id, chunk_index) index, and 011 adds only the five per-user read indexes on sessions, test_results and books.
backend/tests/test_offline.py: Pytest: the suite uses the dummy environment and the fake Supabase client, outbound connections are blocked, loopback works, and a protected endpoint answers 401.
backend/tests/test_retriever.py: Pytest on a mocked database: reciprocal rank fusion, the OR text query, both searches called and fused, one search or the embedder failing, and the unchanged get_similar_chunks signature.
backend/tests/test_requirements.py: Pytest: every third-party package imported under backend/ is in requirements.txt, every line is pinned, and backend/ has no second requirements file.
backend/tests/test_startup.py: Pytest: starting and stopping the app through TestClient spawns no subprocess.
docs/BENCHMARKS.md: Measured numbers with the command, machine and date for each: backend idle memory before and after C3.4, the C4.1 embedding model memory and latency with Gate G2, the C4.4 yake and rapidfuzz memory, the C4.6 ingestion and backfill times, and the C3.5 API baseline with its caveats.
docs/DEBUG_LOG.md: Debug log rules, entry template, and one entry per failure.
docs/MIGRATION_AUDIT.md: Audit from the full read: verdicts on suspected issues, architecture, LLM calls with file:line, schema and RLS, background tasks, dead code, security, risks, files to change.
docs/PROGRESS.md: Sprint tracker: open issues, one row per subchunk for C0-C1, and the C2 plan.

First-session reading speed test: times a 200-word passage and posts the WPM to /auth/profile/calibrate.

frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx: Global nav (wordmark, Library and Dashboard links, email, sign out) wrapped around page content.

frontend/src/components/ui/Button.jsx: Button with variant and loading props.
frontend/src/components/ui/Card.jsx: Card container with an optional hover state; not used by any page.
frontend/src/components/ui/Modal.jsx: Portal modal: closes on Escape and backdrop click, focuses the panel on open, does not trap focus.
frontend/src/components/ui/ScoreBadge.cs: Score badge dot and text styles.
frontend/src/components/ui/ScoreBadge.js: Coloured percentage badge (green from 75, amber from 50, red below); imported by Library but not rendered.
frontend/src/components/ui/Skeleton.jsx: Loading placeholder block with width and height props.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.jsx: AuthProvider and useAuth: Supabase session state plus signIn, signUp and signOut.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageTransition.js: Adds the .visible class on mount and returns navigateTo, which fades the page out before routing.
frontend/src/index.css: Design tokens (ink, paper and amber colours, four font families, 8 px grid), reset, focus ring, and the .page fade.
frontend/src/lib/api.js: fetchApi: adds the Supabase bearer token, calls VITE_API_URL, signs out on 401, throws on a non-OK response.
frontend/src/lib/supabase.js: Creates the browser Supabase client; falls back to a hard-coded project URL and publishable key when the env vars are unset.
frontend/src/main.jsx: React entry: renders App in StrictMode and loads index.css.
frontend/src/pages/ComprehensionTest.css: Styles for the test page: dark timer strip, question dots, slide animations, answer textarea, submitting overlay.
frontend/src/pages/ComprehensionTest.jsx: Five-question timed test (5 minutes): grades each answer in the background on navigation, auto-submits at zero, routes to Results.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.css: Styles for the dashboard: header, stat row, chart frame, book progress cards, feedback quotes, empty states.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: Progress page: streak, words this week, a Recharts score line per book, book progress cards, recent feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Library.css: Styles for the library: upload zone, book rows, processing sweep, empty state; uses transition: all.
frontend/src/pages/Library.jsx: Library page: drag-and-drop upload with a title and author modal, 3-second status polling, book list, delete.
frontend/src/pages/Login.css: Styles for the split login page: quote panel, tabs, form fields; single column below 768 px.
frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx: Sign in and sign up form with a quote panel; collects a display name that is never sent.
frontend/src/pages/ReadingSession.css: Styles for the reading page: chrome bar, sticky timer strip, reason strip, distraction-free mode, reading column with drop cap.
frontend/src/pages/ReadingSession.jsx: Reading page: checks calibration, starts a session, shows the timer and pacing bar, distraction-free mode, finish and abandon (abandon does not call the API).
frontend/src/pages/Results.css: Styles for the results page: large score, verdict colours, per-question breakdown, next-session and re-read panels.
frontend/src/pages/Results.jsx: Results page: animated score, verdict, per-question feedback, next-session or re-read panel; rebuilds from the API after a refresh.
frontend/vercel.json: Vercel config: build command, dist output, and a rewrite of every path to index.html.
frontend/vite.config.js: Vite config: React plugin, an /api dev proxy to port 8000, and a single vendor chunk.
package.json: Root package with one dev dependency, the Supabase CLI.
progress.md: Pre-2.0 progress tracker, kept for history only.
pyrightconfig.json: Pyright config pointing at .venv with pythonVersion 3.14.
pytest.ini: Limits a bare pytest run to backend/tests and tools/repo_graph/tests, so scripts/manual/ is never collected.
render.yaml: Render blueprint for the Docker backend; declares the Supabase keys and FRONTEND_URL, and no AI provider key (since C8.8).
requirements.txt: The only backend dependency list, used by the Dockerfile and CI: every package backend/ imports, pinned, including fastembed, numpy, yake and rapidfuzz for backend/nlp/, langgraph with its langchain-core, and no LLM or embedding API package (since C8.8).
scripts/backfill_local_embeddings.py: Fills chunks.embedding_local for chunks stored before local embeddings: only null rows, in id order, idempotent and resumable, with --dry-run, --limit and --book-id; refuses to run unless ENV=development.
scripts/bench.py: Signs in as dev test user A and times /health, /books, the upload-to-ready and session flow, and /dashboard against a local backend; prints p50/p95 and can write the Baseline section of docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
scripts/dev/check_retriever.py: Integration check of the hybrid retriever on the dev database: inserts sample.pdf's chunks with local embeddings as a fixture book for test user A, runs searches with expected chunks, deletes the fixture; refuses to run unless ENV=development.
scripts/dev/create_test_users.py: Creates or resets two confirmed dev test users and writes .env.test; refuses to run unless ENV=development.
scripts/dev/measure_embedder.py: Measures the embedding model in a fresh process: psutil RSS before and after import, load and batches, model load time, and the latency of a batch of short and of chunk-sized texts.
scripts/dev/measure_rss.py: Starts uvicorn on a spare port, waits for /health, then prints the psutil RSS of the server and every child process.
scripts/manual/README.md: Explains that the eight manual scripts are not tests, need live Supabase, Groq and Google AI Studio, and must not be run during the sprint; lists each script's known problems.
scripts/manual/test_evaluator.py: Manual script: generates a test then grades canned answers against hard-coded user and book ids. Not a pytest test.
scripts/manual/test_generator.py: Manual script: generates questions for a hard-coded book id and prints them. Not a pytest test.
scripts/manual/test_graph.py: Manual script: invokes the workflow with an event_type key that the graph no longer reads. Not a pytest test.
scripts/manual/test_ingest.py: Manual script that runs at import: creates a user and book, then calls ingest_book on sample.pdf without awaiting it.
scripts/manual/test_optimizer.py: Manual script: runs optimize_pace with a 7/50 score against hard-coded ids. Not a pytest test.
scripts/manual/test_orchestrator.py: Manual script: imports orchestrator_node from backend.agents.graph, which does not exist, so it fails at import.
scripts/manual/test_planner.py: Manual script: runs plan_session against hard-coded ids and prints the plan. Not a pytest test.
scripts/manual/test_sessions_api.py: Manual end-to-end script: start, finish-reading and submit-answers through TestClient, authenticating with a raw UUID, which has been rejected with 401 since C3.1.
supabase/.gitignore: Ignores Supabase CLI branch and temp folders and local env key files.
supabase/config.toml: Supabase CLI local-development config (ports, auth, storage), close to the generated defaults.
supabase/migrations/001_initial.sql: Initial schema: pgvector, six tables, the new-user profile trigger, RLS policies, the books bucket, and match_chunks.
backend/agents/policy.py: Policy constants for the agents: every threshold, weight and limit in one place; so far question generation, test assembly, grading, feedback, the knowledge state's mastery update, the reading strategy planner and the learning optimizer.
backend/agents/optimizer/__init__.py: Package marker for backend.agents.optimizer, the bounded learning optimizer with no LLM.
backend/agents/optimizer/pace.py: Learning optimizer, pure: decide(OptimizerInput) sets the next pace multiplier from the rolling score band (80/50/20%, the old optimizer's thresholds), never grows after a low test or recent abandonment, keeps it in the planner's range; queues or prioritises the session's sections for re-reading by this test's band; derives focus minutes from a bounded measured reading speed; and moves one question place to the worst failing type. Keeps the keys Results.jsx reads.
backend/tests/test_optimizer_pace.py: Pytest on hand-made scores, sessions and answers: every score band at its boundaries, the re-read queue rules and bound, rolling damping, no growth after a low test, compounding within bounds, abandonment and its window, focus minutes and speed bounds, question-mix moves and their bounds, reason wording, the Results keys, and that decide is pure.
backend/agents/planner/__init__.py: Package marker for backend.agents.planner, the rule-based reading strategy with no LLM.
backend/agents/planner/strategy.py: Reading strategy, pure: decide(PlannerInput) serves the re-read queue first, otherwise scores the next unread section and every read section with a weak or due concept on weak-concept coverage, unread, difficulty fit and due-for-review (weights in policy.py), extends new reading within the optimizer's word and time target, and returns sections, minutes, a question mix per mode and a one-line reason naming the concept and how often it was missed.
backend/tests/test_planner_strategy.py: Pytest on hand-made chunks and concept states: cold start, a finished book, a weak concept brought back with its reason, re-read queue priority, the score formula and its boundaries, difficulty fit, the optimizer's multiplier and minutes, size and duration bounds, question mixes, and that decide is pure.
Package marker for backend.agents.knowledge_state, per-concept mastery from graded answers with no LLM.
backend/agents/knowledge_state/mastery.p: Mastery update, pure: decide(current_rows, grades, event_id) moves each concept a graded question names (correct closes 30% of the gap to 1, wrong takes 25% away, partial interpolates by score, low confidence at half weight), clamps to 0..1, sets the review interval by mastery band, counts attempts and correct, and skips rows already updated by the same event.
backend/tests/test_mastery.py: Pytest on hand-made rows and grades: the correct, wrong and partial rules and their boundaries, bounds and monotonicity, low-confidence half weight, the prior for untested concepts, counters, review intervals by band, idempotency per event, and that decide is pure.
backend/agents/question_generation/__ini: Package marker for backend.agents.question_generation, questions built from a chunk's own sentences with no LLM.
backend/agents/question_generation/agent: QuestionGenerationAgent.run(book_id, chunk_ids): builds, filters and scores questions for chunks with the local embedder only and upserts them into question_bank (on conflict do nothing); hands each chunk's concepts to the concept store; returns a GenerationReport.
backend/tests/test_question_generation_a: Pytest on an in-memory database and a fake embedder: stored rows are grounded in their chunk, the report matches them, a second run adds nothing, questions per chunk are capped, each chunk's concepts go to the concept store (whose failure loses no question), and no LLM is used.
backend/agents/question_generation/assem: Pure test assembly: picks a session's questions from bank rows by a mix of strategies, preferring unused, difficulty-matched questions; builds the stored form (with answers) and the public form (question, type, options only).
backend/services/question_bank.py: assemble_session_test: reads the bank rows of a session's chunks, generates them on demand for chunks that have none, gives each picked question the concept_keys its key terms name, stores the questions with the session only if it has none yet (otherwise returns the stored test; issue 34) and increments times_used for the run that stored.
backend/services/concept_store.py: The concepts of a book in the concepts table: save upserts one row per (user, book, concept key) for a batch of chunks, keeping the first label, growing chunk_indices and taking the highest weight; concepts_for_chunks reads the concepts some chunks mention; link_key_terms (pure) ties a question's key terms to concept keys.
backend/tests/test_concept_store.py: Pytest on an in-memory concepts table: one row per concept of a book, later batches add their chunks and keep the first label, a repeated batch writes nothing, other books are untouched, and key terms link to concept keys by key or by the words of the key.
backend/tests/test_question_assembler.py: Pytest on hand-made bank rows: the default mix, unused and difficulty preferences, no repeated sentence or answer, spread over chunks, option order, and the public form of a question.
backend/tests/fixtures/answers.json: Labelled answers for calibrating the grader: 34 cases over five questions, each with question, type, evidence, key terms, an answer, a category (correct, paraphrase, partial, wrong, off-topic, empty, copy of the question) and a hand-given human_score from 0 to 1.
backend/tests/test_answer_fixtures.py: Pytest: the labelled answer fixtures have every field, unique ids, every category and type, scores inside their category's band, key terms taken from the evidence, and truly empty and copied answers.
backend/tests/test_api_sessions.py: Pytest on an in-memory database through TestClient, with a bag-of-words fake embedder: tests come from the question bank in one round trip and leak nothing; answers are graded inline with confidence and feedback, pre-grades are cached and reused, a failing embedder or a question with no evidence gives low confidence, test_results keeps the shape the results page and dashboard read, stored questions carry concept_keys, and a submitted test moves the mastery of the concepts it names, once; each workflow run's decisions are stored in order under one run id, a failing decisions insert changes no response, the responses keep the keys the pages read, and abandon runs the optimizer; a resubmitted session returns the stored result and runs nothing again, a failed grading releases the session, and a completed session with no stored result is a conflict; start reads the chunks and creates the session at the same time.
backend/agents/question_generation/quali: Pure quality filter for generated questions: rejects stopword answers, short evidence and prompts that contain the answer, scores the rest 0..1, and drops the weaker of two near-duplicate prompts.
backend/tests/test_question_quality.py: Pytest on hand-made questions and vectors: each reject reason and its boundary, the quality score's range and ranking, near-duplicate handling and the filter's edge cases.
backend/agents/question_generation/strat: Pure extractive question strategies over one chunk's sentences and concepts; every question carries evidence that appears verbatim in the chunk.
backend/tests/test_question_strategies.p: Pytest on fixed text: verbatim sentence spans and each question strategy's prompt, answer and evidence, with no model or database.
supabase/migrations/007_question_bank.sq: Adds the question_bank table (one precomputed question per row, tied to a user, book and chunk) with row-level security, a (user_id, book_id, chunk_index) index and a unique (chunk_id, strategy, prompt_hash) rule.
Adds the concepts table (a book's concepts, unique per user, book and concept key) and user_concept_mastery (a reader's 0..1 mastery, attempts and next review per concept), both with row-level security, and indexes on (user_id, book_id) and (user_id, next_review).
supabase/migrations/006_chunk_text_searc: Adds a GIN full-text index on chunks.content and search_chunks_text (websearch_to_tsquery, ranked), which runs as the caller so RLS applies.
supabase/migrations/005_local_embeddings: Adds chunks.embedding_local vector(384) with an HNSW cosine index and match_chunks_local, which runs as the caller so RLS applies; the 1536 column and match_chunks are untouched.
tools/repo_graph/build.py: Builds docs/repo-graph/graph.json: typed nodes and edges for files, endpoints, tables, functions, env vars, external services and LangGraph nodes; LangGraph wiring is read from non-test files only.
tools/repo_graph/inventory.py: Builds docs/repo-graph/inventory.json: path, language, lines, size, role and purpose for every tracked file, plus the exclusions.
tools/repo_graph/purposes.json: Hand-written one-line purpose for every inventoried file, written after reading it.
tools/repo_graph/query.py: CLI that prints what a file, endpoint, table or other graph node touches and what touches it, from graph.json.
tools/repo_graph/render.py: Renders docs/repo-graph/REPO_MAP.md: Mermaid layer and LangGraph diagrams plus endpoint, table, function, service, env var and file tables.
tools/repo_graph/tests/test_build.py: Pytest: graph edges on a tiny in-memory fixture repo, and coverage of routers and pages in the real graph.
tools/repo_graph/tests/test_inventory.py: Pytest: role, language and exclusion rules, CRLF-safe measuring, purpose checks, and completeness of the real inventory.
tools/repo_graph/tests/test_query.py: Pytest: file, endpoint and table queries, path forms, unknown targets, and the importers of llm.py in the real graph.
tools/repo_graph/tests/test_render.py: Pytest: diagram links, lookup table rows and the file list of the rendered map, on the fixture repo and the real one.
backend/tests/test_agent_nodes.py: Pytest on the in-memory database, each node alone: the planner creates the progress row once, continues after the last section, uses the optimizer's pace and speed, pops a re-read only when a session starts with it, brings a weak concept's section back, reads difficulty from the bank; the test generator stores a test in the plan's mix; the knowledge state reports the rows it moved, moves nothing for a test that names no concept and turns a failure into an errors entry; the optimizer stores its recommendation with history, creates a missing progress row, counts abandoned sessions and moves the mix; one decisions entry each; no LLM.
backend/agents/workflow.py: The only callers of the compiled graph: run_start, run_finish, run_submit and run_abandon invoke one event flow each with a recursion limit of 10 and return the final state; save_decisions stores a run's decisions entries in agent_decisions in one insert, numbered under one run id, logging any failure.
backend/tests/test_graph.py: Pytest: each router function of the graph, the exact set of compiled edges, the recursion limit, and on the in-memory database the submit chain in order, the low-confidence skip of the optimizer, an evaluator error ending the run, the plan after submit as a preview that does not pop the re-read queue, and the start, finish-reading, abandon and unknown-event flows; the exact node visit order of every event from astream(stream_mode='updates'), including the low-confidence branch and an evaluator error; the same submit twice moving mastery once; and the recursion limit enforced, with the four-node submit flow needing five steps.
Adds agent_decisions: one row per node of each agent workflow run (user, book, session, run id, event, step, agent, inputs and output summaries, reason, duration), unique per run and step, indexed by session and by user and book, readable only by its own user under RLS and written by the service role.
scripts/export_agent_graph.py: Writes docs/repo-graph/AGENT_GRAPH.md from the compiled LangGraph workflow: an event table from graph.ENTRY and workflow.get_graph().draw_mermaid(); needs .env, so it is the agent-graph Makefile target, not part of graph.
backend/tests/test_graph_doc.py: Pytest: the committed docs/repo-graph/AGENT_GRAPH.md equals what scripts/export_agent_graph.py renders now, and the diagram has every node and edge of the compiled workflow.
backend/tests/test_no_paid_ai.py: Pytest, hard constraint 1, with the deny-list from tools/no_paid_ai.py: no backend file imports a banned SDK or the LangChain chat-model stack (AST scan), reads a provider key or names a provider at all (Gate G3's grep), requirements.txt lists no banned package and keeps langgraph, .env.example and render.yaml declare no provider key, and the old llm.py and embeddings.py are gone.
tools/no_paid_ai.py: The deny-list for hard constraint 1: banned SDK modules, packages and provider key names, and Gate G3's search pattern; kept outside backend/ so the application names no provider.
backend/tests/test_supabase_client.py: Pytest: the shared Supabase client is built with an httpx client that has HTTP/2 off and postgrest's 120 s timeout.
backend/services/processing_jobs.py: processing_jobs rows for book ingestion: create one queued job per book, the pure claimable rule (done, fresh running, attempt cap), claim with an optimistic update on attempts and updated_at so only one caller runs a job, advance the cursor and progress after each batch, finish, fail, and list stale queued or running jobs for the startup sweep.
backend/tests/memory_db.py: Test helper: an in-memory stand-in for the Supabase client (select, insert, update, upsert with on_conflict and ignore_duplicates, eq, in_, lt, is_, order, limit, range, Storage upload and download), recording each select's columns and window and able to delay every call, for the ingestion, job and dashboard tests.
backend/tests/test_processing_jobs.py: Pytest on the in-memory database: one queued job per book, the claimable rule at each boundary, a racing second claim gets nothing, advance records cursor and progress, finish and fail, which jobs the sweep sees as stale, and the stale window from INGEST_STALE_MINUTES.
Adds processing_jobs (user, book, kind, status queued/running/done/failed, progress, cursor, error, attempts, updated_at), unique per book and kind, indexed on (status, updated_at) for the sweep and readable only by its own user under RLS; adds a unique index on chunks (book_id, chunk_index) so re-run batches upsert.
backend/services/ingestion_worker.py: The ingestion sweep: at startup and once per stale window, claims queued or running processing_jobs not updated within INGEST_STALE_MINUTES and runs them again from their cursor one at a time, or fails them (and a never-ready book) after MAX_ATTEMPTS; INGEST_SWEEP=0 turns it off.
backend/tests/test_ingestion_worker.py: Pytest on the in-memory database: the sweep resumes an abandoned job, leaves a live one and gives up at the attempt cap; a failing sweep does not raise; INGEST_SWEEP; upload creates and runs a job and /status reports it, including a running job's cursor and progress; /resume finishes a failed job, starts a job for a stuck book, refuses a done or live job (409) and another user's book (404).
backend/tests/test_model_ready.py: Pytest: submit-answers and evaluate-single answer 503 with a clear message and Retry-After while the model loads, before touching the session; require_model returns at once when the model is ready and starts a load when none runs.
backend/tests/test_api_dashboard.py: Pytest on the in-memory database with a frozen clock: GET /dashboard returns the response recorded from the pre-C9.4 endpoint, reads answers only for a page of the newest results, pages on until it has three feedback quotes, and issues its reads at once.
supabase/migrations/011_query_indexes.sq: Adds indexes for the per-user reads: sessions (user_id, status, completed_at) and (user_id, book_id), test_results (session_id) and (user_id, created_at), books (user_id, status). Indexes only.
